data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ajd, meaning 'gentle, delicate'. In Islamic tradition, Majda is believed to symbolize grace, elegance, and beauty. The name Majda carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Majda usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majda total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
